thread:
Kai: signal: worried about correctness when we evict tombstones. propose tiny per-prefix 'stale-marker' so demote can force fetch if recent mut exists.

Maya: what guarantee? RA-W within a prefix?

Kai: yes — ensure if writer got ack before reader, reader won't see old state. marker = last-commit-epoch.

Dani: tradeoffs: size & TTL. suggest 8 bytes (epoch+crc), TTL configurable.

Sam: store marker in prefix header to avoid slab churn. update on commit.

Maya: races: writer could commit after demote check. require marker write sync on commit to meet guarantee.

Sam: demote pseudocode: if (marker >= req_epoch) FETCH_REMOTE else SERVE_LOCAL.

Dani: compaction must clear marker when tombstone removed to avoid pinning. migration must copy marker + remaining TTL.

Kai: tests: writer-before/during/after-evict harness. metrics: demote_calls, forced_fetches, false_negatives, marker_bytes.

evict-bot: RFC link: https://redwood.internal/rfc/kv-prefix-marker (auto add watchers)

Maya: +1 sync-on-commit initially. Kai: i'll draft RFC, Dani: you'll add tests, Sam: plan canary.

Sam: :thumbsup:
